name: Hyperithm USDC Apex
oneLiner: hyperUSDCa is Hyperithm's USDC lending vault on Monad; shares earn borrower interest and redeem for liquid USDC, with credit losses reducing NAV.
collateral: USDC held idle or lent through the Hyperithm-curated Morpho Vault V2 on Monad. Its sole MorphoMarketV1AdapterV2 holds nine lender positions, led by aHYPER and PT-USDat collateral; borrower credit and collateral risks remain local strategy exposure.
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 shares accrue net USDC lending interest and realize losses at NAV. No liquidity adapter is configured at the reviewed block, so ordinary withdraw/redeem uses idle USDC. Permissionless force-deallocation and in-kind exits are separate routes, not guaranteed dollar settlement. VaultV2 maxWithdraw and maxRedeem deliberately return zero as conservative underestimates, not measurements of available exit liquidity. At the reviewed pin, the current adapter's force-deallocation penalty is 0% of assets deallocated; this separate route still requires market liquidity and is not an ordinary withdrawal fee.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Monad block 113592449, hash 0xe28608349f55c565f97911ad6364f00301b952fa3749889c07ce8568eed73140, timestamp 2026-10-15T10:44:05Z: hyperUSDCa is the exact native ERC-4626 VaultV2 share over Monad USDC 0x754704bc059f8c67012fed69bc8a327a5aafb603. Deposit-backed issuance and accrued fee shares preserve proportional residual NAV accounting; strategy losses reduce share value. The sole adapter 0x068f22739a5f8a5c84619d7f355b678d00707908 has nine nonzero lender markets. Holder rights are code-enforced redemption into available USDC, not direct ownership of Circle reserves or proven legal segregation. Other Hyperithm USDC Apex vaults on Ethereum and Arbitrum are distinct native liabilities, not additional deployments of this Monad share.
